x_1577958_dsb_pattern.name: Greenfield scoped application (App Engine)
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.overview: Prove the gap, design small, secure first, test always. (1) Fit-to-standard: search OOB apps and existing tables (evidence ae.fit); only proceed with a design-authority decision. (2) Scoped application created with App Engine Studio or the Fluent SDK (now-sdk) — source-controlled. (3) Minimal data model: one primary table (extend Task only if work is assigned and SLA-tracked), child/reference tables only where needed; choices and properties over hard-coding. (4) Roles and ACLs from a persona matrix before any UI. (5) Flow Designer for approvals, notifications and integrations; no business-rule workflows. (6) UI Builder workspace for fulfillers, portal/Employee Center record producer for requesters. (7) ATF from the first sprint: critical path plus one access test per persona. (8) Governance: owner, App Engine Management Center or pipeline, app repository deployment, support model, and a custom-table count against entitlement. The workbench greenfield skeleton seeds the component list; this pattern adds the governance and evidence around it.
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.pain: Critical process lives in a spreadsheet or legacy database with no audit trail No approvals, SLAs or notifications Previous quick builds became unowned technical debt Custom-table licence consumption unknown No standard for citizen developers

x_1577958_dsb_pattern.summary: A business process has no fit in an OOB application and runs on spreadsheets, an Access/Lotus database or a SharePoint list. The client wants it on the platform quickly without creating unmanaged technical debt. The pattern converges on a governed scoped application: fit-to-standard check first, a minimal data model extending Task only where work is assigned, roles and ACLs designed up front, Flow Designer for logic, a workspace/portal UI, ATF from day one, and App Engine governance (Management Center, pipelines, custom-table entitlement) — built with App Engine Studio or the Fluent SDK.
